items.title: SSL-RUL: Self-Supervised Predictive Maintenance Framework
items.summary: Developed a self-supervised LSTM framework using masked reconstruction learning for predictive maintenance. Achieved 48.6% RMSE improvement on C-MAPSS with reduced labeled data.
highlights: Self-supervised LSTM with masked reconstruction learning
items.source_note: Venue taken from the SSL-RUL project description on the portfolio.

items.title: Synthetic Taphonomic Deformation — Paleontological AI
items.summary: This research pipeline processes 3D CT slice stacks of fossil specimens (8 specimens x 30 projections = 240 images per specimen) via orthographic maximum intensity projection (MIP) and rotational view generation. Outputs are used to train a deep learning Taphonomic Distortion Estimator that predicts morphological deformation caused by sedimentary burial. Implemented with ASCII-safe encoding for cross-platform Windows/Linux compatibility. Collaborative paleontological research project at VIT Chennai.
